input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. Section 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right to deliver the Services (and Section 15.1 bars sale, advertising use, commingling and model training). Section 14.2 gives Customer ownership of each Deliverable with an express Vendor assignment, personnel assignments and further-assurance covenant. Section 14.3 leaves Vendor with its pre-existing Vendor Technology but routes embedded Vendor Technology to the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business. Section 14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument identifying exploitation rights, and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted rights. Minor points noted only: ownership of Deliverables is conditioned on payment of Fees, and Vendor may process Customer material to "improve the Services for Customer" — both are within market norms and do not assign Customer IP or data, so no redline.
